messages:
maya: quick thread 1: posted a compact mock for the "scope swap" spend view. link: https://redwood.design/proto/scope-swap-compact :eyes:
aj: skimmed. clean. quick points: scope toggle ambiguous about preserving time range and denom.
sam: +1. flipping org->project resets denom to USD. can we remember denom per user? :exclamation:
kyle: a11y: legend chips drop below 4:1 contrast in dark theme. bump bg to token-neutral-300. toggle needs aria-label (screen readers read 'button').
olivia: invoice CTA: prefer contextual label ("Download project invoice" / "Download org invoice") and show disabled tooltip for non-admins.
billing-bot: FYI invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for non-admins. UI should map to "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted".
aj: layout choice: left-rail persistent token breakdown vs compact card above chart. desktop favours left-rail; mobile needs compact collapsible. Persist collapse state per user.
maya: plan: 1) aria + contrast fixes (kyle) 2) persist denom (sam) 3) contextual invoice CTA + disabled tooltip (olivia) 4) left-rail on desktop, collapsible card on mobile (aj) 5) map invoice 404 to friendly copy (aj + billing-bot). I'll push updated figma and a tiny A/B by EOD.
